positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
· Led the design, development, and delivery of multiple greenfield applications, mastering and implementing a variety of technologies such as AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, Cloudbees, Snowflake, Parquet, RabbitMQ, Quarkus, Gradle, React, Angular, Kotlin, Java, Typescript, Python, and SQL
· Actively filled knowledge gaps by becoming subject matter expert in multiple new technologies, overcoming adoption challenges, and mentoring colleagues, contributing to a collaborative and high-performing engineering team
· Established and enforced code quality standards by implementing comprehensive testing, coverage reporting, linters, and build enforcement in new code modules, improving build and deploy speed and cultivating a culture of quality within the team
· Authored comprehensive documentation and leveraged expertise in debugging tools to educate others, thereby boosting team productivity by promoting a culture of knowledge sharing and enhancing team's ability to effectively debug and resolve issues

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
· Enabled go-live of web application by leading the design and development of several core features using tools such as Angular, .NET Core, Typescript, HTML, SCSS, C#, SQL, Azure, and Git
· Ensured successful adoption and user satisfaction of said app by identifying, fixing, and refactoring many critical areas in the system that hindered usability and maintainability, while emphasizing clean code and decreasing latency of REST calls by factors of 10 to 100
· Spearheaded initiatives that increased number of unit tests from 0 to over 150, improved coding standards by setting up linter, and enforced quality assurance by modifying CI pipelines to fail the build if any errors in unit tests or linting encountered

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
· Delivered highly visible products by collaborating with various stakeholders and designing and developing significant software components using tools such as Angular, .NET Core, Typescript, HTML, SCSS, C#, SQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, TeamCity, and Git
· Lead development of core feature in web application which performed typeahead search and displayed results for partial and full matches of user input by utilizing state management library NGXS and microservice-oriented REST API
· Contributed to fulfillment of company initiative by acting as a key member of team developing greenfield mobile application utilizing responsive web design practices in Angular and implementing RESTful API endpoints and SQL stored procedures
· Ensured robustness of said products and features by leading initiative to improve test coverage
